signal: Orum shipped a redesigned AI Dialer and now powers over a billion calls for 1,200-plus revenue teams to shorten SDR ramp

email.body1:
Connor, saw Orum ship the redesigned AI Dialer with the billion-calls and 1,200-team milestone.

Growth like that usually means more in-market revenue teams fit your ICP than the sales team can personally cover, and uncovered accounts are where quota quietly slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Orum off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Connor, quick follow-up for Orum.

As the product expands, the pipeline target usually grows faster than you can staff for. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Orum needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Connor, last bit of proof for Orum.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Orum's reply rate likely compares to other sales-tech startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Connor, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Rolling out a redesigned product is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a sales-tech motion? I will tailor it to Orum either way.
